notes.title: Beta Questline Complete
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This new patch is going to be the biggest change. In it we have:

-Ability to Quit to Desktop from the Title Screen
-The entire Xing story is complete, from start to finish! This includes the finale, final dungeon, and epilogue.
-As mentioned before, the Terra storyline has been removed. Instead, players will automatically start the game at the start of the Xing story. 

There is more to be added, as this isn't the complete game yet, but the story itself is finished.

notes.title: About The Silence
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Apologies for the silence of late. The unfortunate bit about being a solo creater is that if something eats up my time there's nobody to pick up my slack.

HOWEVER! I have still been working and thinking on Heaven And Earth, and there is some bittersweet news to share.

The bad news is that I realized I was biting off more than I could chew by trying to create a split-path game without any help, so I will be changing it to a single path experience as of the next update, and looking at implementing the Terra storyline another time.

The good news? That means that the final product will be done significantly sooner! The finale is in the works as I type this, and will be done by the end of the week (maybe sooner). Once that is done, it will just be a matter of fine-tuning the experience and ironing out any kinks, and then we'll have the final product! 

If you have any thoughts to share on the news, please feel free to voice them. 

I hope everyone has a wonderful week, and I'll see you later!

notes.title: Xing Story Achieved
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, how are you doing this fine weekend?

We've been hard at work, and unless there was some janky bug in the uploading process we have a stable version of the game with the entire Xing storyline up until the Finale! 

The update is live for both Mac and PC. And it is still Early Access, so expect everything to be polished further before full release, but hopefully you enjoy!

...yeah, that's it. Go forth and experience the ups and downs of the Xing siblings!

notes.title: Beta Branch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

There were a host of weird bugs that came out with the latest version of the game, which slowed things down a bit as those needed to be addressed. The majour ones should all be fixed now, however. 

In light of this: before moving forward with more content in the 'live' version there will be heavier testing being done on builds before they go up to make sure there aren't any more random game-breaking bugs. You can still take part and get the most recent content, but you will need to opt in for the Beta version if you want the content before we can finish testing for stability.

We're still plugging away at things, working to craft the ultimate RPG experience, though, so expect to hear more soon!

notes.title: Direction of Heaven And Earth
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Michael here, to let you all know what's currently in the works for Heaven And Earth. 

Currently, work is being done to update all enemy art to the unique stylings courtesy of Urahana, and looking into potentially getting more voice acting done with the help of Xotri and friends. 

As well, in terms of work on the different paths, the plan right now is to work through the entirety of the Xing storyline up to the Endgame. From there, I'm uncertain if we'll finish the Endgame through the Xing storyline or catch up the Terra storyline to the Endgame and then release the Endgames simultaneously. Regardless, the Xing storyline is not expected to be finished until the end of September. 

If any of you have any preferences, or are just clamoring for more of that Terra family goodness, please reach out and contact us either by e-mail or by leaving a message here with your thoughts! 

Hope this helps keep y'all in the loop. 

Enjoy!~
